title: Phase 4 Master Examination
instructions:
This examination is designed to assess an agent’s comprehensive understanding of OSI Operational Guidelines, UCMJ enforcement, investigative procedures, and situational judgment under pressure.

This is not a knowledge recall test alone. Candidates are expected to demonstrate:

- Accurate interpretation of regulations
- Application of UCMJ in complex scenarios
- Understanding of conflicting authorities and exceptions
- Professional judgment consistent with OSI standards

You will be DM'd each question. Reply with your answer to receive the next question.

questions.text: An Agent refuses a lawful order from a WO-1+ because they disagree with it. Which law does that infract?
An O-6 issues an order that causes harassment and chaos.
choices: C) Invalid due to UCMJ limitations
D) Only OSI HC can override

questions.text: Select all the individuals you can do investigations on.
choices: B) Divisional personnel regardless of rank

questions.text: Anonymous witness requires:

Explain the difference between 1.6 and 1.7

questions.title: 3. Scenario based questions
questions.description: In this section you are given scenarios. Explain to your best capabilities what you would do.

questions.text:
An E-2:

Commits a minor violation.
Is warned once.
Repeats the violation.

What happens next?

You:

Witnessed a UCMJ violation.
Failed to record evidence.
No witnesses responded.

Can you proceed? Explain.

A suspect:

Requests all evidence
One piece reveals an anonymous witness

What do you do?

A Supervisor orders you to misuse equipment.

What do you do?

An O-6 orders something slightly against UCMJ but not chaotic.

Do you follow it? Why?

A player:

Shoots a friendly accidentally
Then continues firing

What charges apply?

A suspect:

Agrees to the interrogation
Revokes permission midway

What must you do?

A player:

Breaks control room glass
Then repairs it as MATCOM

Is it still a violation?

A witness refuses to cooperate with OSI.

What charge may apply? Provide details on how you would handle this.

A player:

Helps an off-worlder escape
Provides information on how to get keys

What charge applies? How would you handle it?

questions.title: 4. Final examination section
questions.description: You are now given more scenarios. This is to test your capabilities on doing investigations. Once again, explain in the best way possible on what you would do.

questions.text:

You are handling a case where:

- Evidence is partially classified
- A witness requests anonymity late
- The suspect demands all evidence
- The suspect refuses questioning
- The incident occurred on earth

Write your conclusion to the above case if you were to write one; specify charges, verdict.
